q1.a: An AI lesson is one analysis of material added by the student. This can be up to 5 photos of notes or 1 PDF/DOCX document. After adding material, OmniNauka helps understand the topic, conducts a conversation with the AI Tutor, and can prepare a quiz.

q2.q: How does a quiz differ from a test?
q2.a: A quiz with explanations is a short training session after a lesson. It helps check basic understanding of the topic and shows why an answer is right or wrong. A test with an error report is a larger readiness test for a pop quiz or exam. At the end, the student receives a score and information on which topics to review.

q3.a: Premium+ is a plan for students preparing for major exams, such as the eighth-grade exam or matura. It includes exam-style tasks, mock exams, and error reports.

q4.q: Will OmniNauka prepare me for the eighth-grade and matura exams?
q4.a: Yes, we are planning an exam mode for the eighth-grade exam and matura. This will be a separate module developed after the basic version of the application.

q5.q: Is OmniNauka an official tool of the CKE (Central Examination Board)?
q5.a: No. OmniNauka is not an official tool of the CKE. The exam mode will be created as a study support, with exam-style tasks and materials inspired by examination requirements.

q6.q: Can I add a PDF or Word document?
q6.a: Yes. OmniNauka supports JPG, PNG, WEBP photos, text PDF files, and DOCX documents. Scanned PDFs may require adding pages as photos.

q7.q: Does OmniNauka solve tasks for the student?
q7.a: The goal of OmniNauka is not to provide ready answers without learning. The AI Tutor helps understand the material, explains mistakes, asks questions, and guides the student step by step.

q8.a: During the beta version stage, payments and limits may be launched in stages. Current packages show the planned usage model for OmniNauka.

about.title: About us
about.p1: OmniNauka is a modern AI tutor for students. It helps understand material from notes, photos, PDFs, and Word documents, conducts a conversation with the AI Tutor, creates quizzes, and supports error reviews.
about.p2: We create an application that does not do the work for the student but helps them truly understand the topic.
about.p3: OmniNauka is being developed as a mobile-first product — simple, fast, and convenient for students using mostly phones or tablets.
